subject: [PATCH 5/9] memcg: remove the soft limit rbtree

2026-08-13.patch_summary: This patch removes the soft limit rbtree from the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) subsystem. The tree was used to maintain a list of cgroups that exceeded their soft limits, but since reclaiming from these cgroups is no longer necessary, the tree can be removed along with its associated helpers and initialization code. This change simplifies the memcg code and reduces memory usage.
